description: Unlinks a previously established external team from a Sentry team; this action does not delete either the Sentry team or the external team.

external_team_id.description: Numeric ID of the external team integration, typically obtained when the link was established.
external_team_id.title: External Team Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: Unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

team_id_or_slug.description: Unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry team.
team_id_or_slug.title: Team Id Or Slug

name: delete_external_team_by_id

success.description: Indicates whether the external team link was successfully deleted.
success.title: Success
